description: React component for an editable content block with drag-and-drop, tag selection, image upload, and context menus.

classes.name: EditableBlock
classes.description: A React class component representing an editable content block with rich editing features.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initializes placeholder and sets state based on props when component mounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Updates server-side content when local state changes after editing.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles content change in editable area.

methods.name: handleFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event, removes placeholder if present.

methods.name: handleBlur
methods.description: Handles blur event, adds placeholder if content is empty.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down events for commands, backspace, and enter.

methods.name: handleKeyUp
methods.description: Handles key up event to trigger tag menu on '/' key.

methods.name: handleMouseUp
methods.description: Handles mouse up to detect text selection and open action menu.

methods.name: handleDragHandleClick
methods.description: Opens action menu on drag handle click.

methods.name: openActionMenu
methods.description: Calculates position and opens the action menu.

methods.name: openTagSelectorMenu
methods.description: Calculates position and opens the tag selector menu.

methods.name: handleTagSelection
methods.description: Handles selection of a new tag, including image insertion.

methods.name: handleImageUpload
methods.description: Uploads an image file and updates image URL in state.

methods.name: addPlaceholder
methods.description: Adds placeholder text for empty first block.

methods.name: calculateActionMenuPosition
methods.description: Calculates position for action menu based on trigger.

methods.name: calculateTagSelectorMenuPosition
methods.description: Calculates position for tag selector menu based on trigger.
